routes.note: Spec said /inward/new at top-level. Relocated under /admin/* to reuse S1's AdminLayout sidebar (deviation documented). Functionally equivalent.

design_choices.topic: Routes mounted under /admin/* instead of top-level
design_choices.rationale: ui_spec said /inward/new, /sales/new, /adjustments/new at top level. Implementing those would require either duplicating the S1 sidebar layout or restructuring into a (shell) route group — significant churn. /admin/* nesting reuses AdminLayout verbatim; nav grouping handles the user-perceived separation between Masters and Transactions.
design_choices.impact_on_tests: None — tests don't reference URLs. router.refresh() is mocked.
design_choices.reversibility: Trivial — rename folders if a top-level path is later required.

design_choices.topic: designsApi.getGradesWithCb lives in api/transactions.ts as 'designsTxApi', NOT extended onto S1's designsApi
design_choices.rationale: S1's lib/api/masters.ts is the existing integration boundary for S1. Extending it would mix S1 + S2 concerns. Keeping S2 endpoints in transactions.ts isolates them — integration time, Sonnet rewrites only transactions.ts to swap mocks. S1's masters.ts stays untouched.
design_choices.tradeoff: Components consume the same design through two paths: designsApi.getGrades (S1, master.ts) for Inward/Sales auto-populate, and designsTxApi.getGradesWithCb (S2, transactions.ts) for Adjustment. The naming asymmetry is documented; both file paths are stable.

design_choices.topic: UR-W008 fix: useEffect on gradesQ.data / gradesWithCbQ.data → replace(lines)
design_choices.rationale: Per the UI review, field-array population must be reactive to React Query refetches, not one-shot. Implemented via useEffect dependency on the query data.

design_choices.topic: UR-W007 fix: types/transactions.ts uses canonical names
design_choices.rationale: Did NOT introduce a parallel 'GradeReadMin' type. Inward/Sales line auto-populate continues to use S1's DesignGradeMin (re-exported from types/masters.ts). The S2 DF-003 contract type is DesignGradeReadWithCb {grade_id, grade_code, software_cb}, distinct from DesignGradeMin (no software_cb).

design_choices.topic: Zero-difference adjustment lines still persist (server-side); client always sends every line
design_choices.rationale: T-049 service skips the ledger write when difference == 0 but persists the audit row. Client sends all lines unmodified. Mirror of T-049 design.

design_choices.topic: Validation strategy: zod (client) + Pydantic (server) + DB CHECK
design_choices.rationale: Defense in depth per layer. Client zod is UX-level, not security.

warnings_carried_from_review.resolution: types/transactions.ts uses canonical names; no parallel GradeReadMin alias introduced. Inward/Sales reuse S1's DesignGradeMin via masters.ts (designsApi.getGrades returns DesignGradeMin[]).
Each of the 3 forms uses useEffect([query.data, replace]) → replace(lines) to reactively sync field-array with refetched query data.

responsive_implementation.mobile_breakpoint: default (< 640px) — single-column header grid; line rows use 2-col compact layout (label | input)
responsive_implementation.tablet_breakpoint: sm: (>= 640px) — 2-col header grid; line rows expand to multi-col (label | input | extras)
responsive_implementation.desktop_breakpoint: lg: — same as tablet plus generous max-width on outer container (admin layout provides max-w-6xl)
responsive_implementation.sticky_submit: Submit button uses flex justify-end at form-level; admin layout's pt-14 on mobile keeps top bar visible; submit button always reachable via scroll

lock_policy: Per ASES rule 6 (execution agent never touches UI scaffold — only integration_points), after this scaffold lands Sonnet may ONLY edit function bodies in integration_points[].file (currently only frontend/src/lib/api/transactions.ts). Deleting mocks.ts is permitted once all 6 integration_points are swapped to apiClient calls. Any structural change (new component, new route, layout change) requires a new ui-design → ui-review → ui-scaffold cycle.
